card.name: Linking words in drug-interaction lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'or', commas and 'containing' that come right after an item in a list of interacting agents, most often potassium supplements and salt substitutes.

modes.label: Potassium list joiners
modes.description: The 'or' or comma after 'potassium supplements' or 'salt substitutes' in warnings about raised potassium.

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: A linking word such as 'containing', 'of' or 'at' that follows a noun and leads into the next item or qualifier.
